title: Haye shaame ghariban
body:
jis shaam jalaye gaye sadaat ke qayyaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
paywast hai khanjar ki tarha dil pe wo hangaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ban ke rida ban ke sare noke sina hai
shola hai dhuan hai
hai jo tahe zanjeer tahe tauq tahe naam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ka tawaf ab bhi usi tarha hai jaari
ek zauf hai taari
khola hi nahi waqt ne us shaam ka ehraam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis shaam ki ghurbat ne dukhaya dil e sajjad
rulaya dil e sajjad
zainab ne jise shaam e ghariban ka diya naam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye saare azal saare abad jis mein sameine
ab kya kahoo haye
jis mein simat aaya hai har aghaaz har anjaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ti hai wohi aandhiya kat jaata hai seena
phat jaata hai seena
har shaam mujhe yaad dilaati hai wohi shaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis raakh mein dil mera naved aah daba hai
aur raakh hua hai
us raakh mein reh reh ke bhadakti hai wohi shaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
author: Ahmed Naved
